description: This file defines a code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page related to setting up exam questions, including event handlers for button clicks that navigate to different parts of an online examination system.

classes.name: SetExam1
classes.description: A partial class for the ASP.NET WebForm page that manages navigation actions within the online examination system.

methods.description: Event handler for profile button; currently no implementation.

methods.description: Handles click event to navigate to the TheorySet page.
